SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund, '否') <> '是' AND platform_type = 'APP' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-01-31' LIMIT 500

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ platform_type AS platform, ROUND(SUM(payment_amount), 2) AS sales_amount FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund, '否') <> '是' GROUP BY platform_type ORDER BY platform_type ASC LIMIT 500

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ product_id, ROUND(SUM(payment_amount), 2) AS sales_amount FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund, '否') <> '是' GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= (SELECT DATE_SUB(MAX(order_date), INTERVAL '6' DAY) FROM orders) AND order_date <= (SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders) AND order_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund, '否') <> '是' LIMIT 500

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(payment_amount), 0), 2) AS refund_amount FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED' AND (is_refund = '是' OR order_status = 'REFUNDED') LIMIT 500

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_refund = '是' OR order_status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS refund_rate FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED' LIMIT 500
SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS valid_user_count FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund, '否') <> '是' LIMIT 500

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ ROUND(SUM(payment_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund, '否') <> '是' LIMIT 500

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund, '否') <> '是' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 500

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2025-02-01' AND order_date < '2025-03-01' THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-02-01' THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-02-01' THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund, '否') <> '是' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-03-01' LIMIT 500

WITH m AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date <= '2026-01-31' THEN payment_amount END) AS cur_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-01-31' THEN payment_amount END) AS base_amt FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund, '否') <> '是' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2026-01-31') SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ ROUND((cur_amt - base_amt) / NULLIF(base_amt, 0) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_rate_pct FROM m LIMIT 500

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS refund_order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'CANCELLED' AND (is_refund = '是' OR order_status = 'REFUNDED') AND payment_amount > 100 LIMIT 500

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(10000) */ channel_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund, '否') <> '是' GROUP BY channel_id ORDER BY channel_id ASC LIMIT 500
